SCBA-TX Annual Symposium

May 12, 2026

We attended the 39th SCBA-TX/CBIS-TX Annual Symposium.

Thanks to the organizing committee for the opportunity to present our research. Dr. Zhao delivered a featured talk, while Zhiyuan and Rui gave oral presentations on their projects. After two rounds of competition, Zhiyuan won the Third Place Presentation Award, and Rui earned an Honorable Mention Award. Congratulations to both! 👏
